stance_rationale: 현재 패키지는 design-only 선언으로 핵심 산출물(alpha_scores.parquet, weights.csv, covariance.parquet, factor_engine_proposal.R, challenge_note)을 제출하지 않아 RF-A1~A7 및 PIT C1~C15를 검증할 수 없다. 더 치명적으로 max_names 20 hard, Universe KOSPI200∪KOSDAQ150, Cost 15bps hard mandate를 union 40, KR_TOP500_LIQ1E8, 25bps로 우회한다.

critical_concerns.description: Verification artifacts are absent: alpha_scores.parquet, weights.csv, covariance.parquet, factor_engine_proposal.R, alpha_package.json final, risk/optimization packages, and challenge_note are missing, so RF-A1~A7 and AX-008 cannot pass.

The design silently overrides hard constraints by allowing blend_max_names_union=40, KR_TOP500_LIQ1E8 ranking universe, 1e8 ranking liquidity, and 25bps comp cost despite max_names=20 hard, Universe=KOSPI200∪KOSDAQ150, Liquidity=2e8, Cost=15bps.

The core claim that disjoint holdings imply cor(NAV_comp,NAV_1715)<=0.3 is not valid; common KR beta, sector, style, and liquidity exposures can keep NAV correlations high even with zero ticker overlap.
WT_003 G1 recall was 0.0893, while the proposed fixes are expected-value narratives; several expected recall numbers remain below the 0.60 gate and no OOS metric exists.
IC diagnostics are entirely unavailable: rank_IC, ICIR, Harvey 5-spec t-stat, DSR, sub-stability, monotonicity, sector-neutral decay, liquidity, and recent-overfit tests are not measured.
PIT compliance is asserted but not auditable; production NAV/regime-derived features create circularity risk unless exact t-1 extraction and usable-date lineage are shown.
The 832-character mechanism violates the role prompt's '<200자' requirement and mixes conditional defense, timing, and NAV allocation without a compact causal chain.

supporting_arguments: The package honestly preserves WT_003 failures: recall 0.0893, cor 0.9997, and cross-base mismatch 2.87x are explicitly stated.
The four markdown design artifacts exist in stage_artifacts/WT_D20260517_004 and give a coherent Phase B/C protocol.
The design includes explicit fail cutoffs and does not claim measured IC performance.
unresolved_disputes: Whether discovery_design_phase_a is allowed to bypass the base rule that every alpha_package must provide time-series alpha_scores.parquet.
Whether L-279 multi-sleeve precedent can override the explicit max_names=20 hard constraint.
Whether KR_TOP500_LIQ1E8 and 25bps comp cost are mandate-compliant or require a formal infeasibility/challenge note.
Whether p_bad features from production NAV/regime states can be made PIT-clean without same-day circularity.
weakest_assumption: Zero ticker overlap plus NAV-level blending is assumed to make cor(NAV_comp,NAV_1715)<=0.3 likely, but portfolio return correlation is driven by common factor exposures, not only holdings overlap.
rebuttal_required: Produce actual alpha_scores.parquet with Date x Ticker x score across >=60 sig_dates, and report schema/date range.
Provide measured RF-A1~A7 diagnostics: rank_IC, ICIR, Harvey 5-spec t_NW, DSR, sub-stability, monotonicity, sector-neutral decay, liquidity, and recent 3Y ICIR.
Resolve or formally challenge hard-constraint conflicts: union 40, KR_TOP500_LIQ1E8, 1e8 ranking liquidity, and 25bps comp cost.
Submit challenge_note.md and artifact_lineage.json showing write_json -> record_lineage order.
Demonstrate PIT C2/C4/C9/C13/C14/C15 with code-level lineage, not only design text.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: This is a protocol draft, not an alpha package that can pass QEPM alpha admission. Treat it as an input to Phase B only after hard-constraint override questions are resolved.

alpha_specific_questions: Can this factor maintain t_NW > 2.95 in KR market after the 720-trial G1/a_max/label search space is deflated?
Can the alpha vector prove no future leakage from production NAV, M4/R05 regime states, and fundamental lag handling?
If AX-007 exemption is claimed through multi-sleeve and ML sizing, what formal rule permits union 40 against max_names 20 hard?
